text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
*yaaawn*... Huh, Dia-chan...? Did we 
have... class today...?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, you're off today. It's totally fine to 
go back to sleep. Get some good rest, 
Kita-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"...We gave that festival everything we 
had. I want to face you again next year... 
at the Arima Kinen."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Me too. Ehehe... I'll definitely 
win next time...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Sorry! ...Did I keep you waiting?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
No, I just got here. ...So? What did you 
want to talk about in person?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to find out why Kura-chan ran in 
the Arima Kinen before heading overseas.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Because distance aptitude-wise, it 
shouldn't be a race you'd aggressively 
target, right? Besides, both Kita-chan and 
I, who specialize in long distance, are 
running too."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, the reason you ran... ...was it 
for my sake?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Are you giving me, someone who ran the 
entire Classic Triple Crown, a chance to 
challenge you?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Actually, when I saw Kura-chan's name on 
the Arima Kinen entry list, I got super 
excited too."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I thought that in this special festival 
with Kita-chan, I might even be able to 
surpass you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
To you, who embodied the dream I yearned 
to fulfill before I could. Today of all 
days—...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Though you already know how it turned 
out. She was so strong... I never imagined 
she'd be so far out of reach.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
After completing the Autumn Senior Triple 
Crown, Kura-chan drifted even further 
away. Just when I thought I finally had 
her back in my sights, she vanished out of 
reach again...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, this time you're going across 
the ocean, to a place even further out of 
reach—"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Dia.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—That's why even crossing an ocean is 
nothing to me!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Don't think you can just run away with it! 
My revenge isn't over yet!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many years or decades it 
takes. Even if you set records across the 
ocean, I'll set great records of my own 
that won't lose to yours!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Even if we end up on different stages, I 
will—I will surpass your light!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...I knew it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You hate losing just as much as I do, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Don't think you can surpass me so easily, 
though. I have goals of my own. The next 
time you see me... I will undoubtedly be 
at even greater heights."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If you still wish to chase after me even 
then— By all means, bring it on.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(...I can't help but sigh. How on earth is 
this girl so strong?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(If I were in her shoes... If there were 
an Umamusume right before my eyes 
achieving everything I ever wanted to 
accomplish――)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: “...I won't lose!”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...No, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Kura-chan? What's wrong? Why did you 
stop?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, sorry! I guess we really are cut 
from the same cloth after all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(If only I were like you. If only I had 
been surpassed by you――)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
(Just like you, I must have spent all my 
time gazing up at the pinnacle.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
—, Kura-chan. What are your plans after 
this?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm planning to go to Papa's brand to 
order a suit for Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I'm the top contender for this 
year's URA Horse of the Year award, aren't 
I?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Wah. That's sooooo much confidence.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
...Then maybe I should go get a dress 
tailored too. As one of the nominees for 
the URA Award for Best Classic Generation 
Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ehh. Are you really going to compete over 
that?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Right!
